text:
Maya: Huge thanks to @Lee and @Devon for swooping in last night — demo saved, espresso delivered, and the office fish is alive! 🐟👏
Lee: yesss. team caffeine + rescue squad activated. also shoutout to @Sophie for fronting the emergency coffee fund ☕️❤️
Devon: no biggie, happy to help. surprisingly calm once we put a towel over the tank lol :sweat_smile:
Sophie: glad it worked out! quick tip: keep a travel filter cartridge in the supply cabinet (saved us 10min)
AJ: defs adding a travel filter to the office checklist. also can we get a tiny plaque for "Buffer, Demo Rescuer"? :trophy:
Nora: love this. sending a little thank-you care package to Lee + Devon today — plants + biscotti? choices: (1) biscotti, (2) sourdough, (3) fancy instant coffee
Maya: @Nora biscotti pls. and maybe a sticker that says "I saved the demo" :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
kudos-bot: +1 to everyone who helped — 3 people recognized (Lee, Devon, Sophie). Sending kudos points now. :star:
Lee: ha, the sticker idea is excellent. also here's the 2-line emergency script Devon ran to rehome Buffer temporarily:
```
# move fish to travel tank
netcat -l 8080 >/dev/null &
```
Devon: that's a joke, but also the towel+bucket method was surprisingly low-tech and effective.
Sophie: minor PSA: kitchen mugs in the drying rack are fair game after 48h unless labeled. put names on fav mugs pls :grin:
AJ: quick poll — who wants a "Buffer" plushie at the next all-hands? react with :+1: for yes, :wave: for no
Maya: also huge props to the infra folks who stayed late during the demo — saw a couple of alerts get handled slickly. real cross-team heroics tonight. :muscle:
Nora: note for rewards program: two small care packages + sticker + kudos points allocated. thanks all for stepping in! :heart:
Maya: thanks again everyone. made me proud to work with you all. <3
